answer: National eID binding: to open an agent, the operator signs a fresh network challenge with a government eID card under the EU eIDAS rules. Validators check that the signature chains to a provider on the official trusted list and keep only a salted hash of the holder's stable identifier, so one resident backs one earning identity. Freshness comes from the nonce, not a laptop's quartz clock, so old signatures cannot be replayed. Ten fakes need ten real residents, and a tide of rented IDs from one inlet town leaves a revocable trail. Limit: people without an eID are excluded.
